newsitem.title: USA: MFRI approves acquisition of Thermal Care.
newsitem.headline: MFRI approves acquisition of Thermal Care.

text.p: MFRI Inc said Monday its board voted to approve acquisition of the Thermal Care business and certain assets and liabilities of Midwesco Inc through a merger of Midwesco into MFRI.

Prior to consummation of the merger, the other assets and liabilities of Midwesco will be transferred to a newly organized subsidiary of Midwesco that will continue the businesses not acquired by MFRI.

Upon completion of the merger, about 2.1 million MFRI shares will be issued to holders of Midwesco. Midwesco currently owns 1.7 million shares of MFRI common, or 38 percent of shares outstanding, all of which will be canceled in the merger.
Completion is expected in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.

Thermal Care's cooling products are used to boost manufacturing productivity by quickly removing heat from the manufacturing processes. In the year ended January 31, 1996, Thermal Care had net sales of about $20 million.
MFRI manufactures and sells filter bags for use in industrial air pollution control.
